def solve_cyk(grammar_str, string_to_check):
    rules = collections.defaultdict(list)
    terminal_rules = collections.defaultdict(list)

    for line in grammar_str.strip().split('\n'):
        parts = line.split(' -> ')
        lhs = parts[0].strip()
        rhs = parts[1].strip()
        if rhs.startswith("'"):
            terminal_rules[rhs.strip("'")].append(lhs)
        else:
            rules[tuple(rhs.split())].append(lhs)

    words = string_to_check.split()
    n = len(words)
    
    # dp_table[length_minus_1][start_index]
    dp_table = [[set() for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]

    # Fill diagonal (length 1 substrings)
    for i, word in enumerate(words):
        if word in terminal_rules:
            dp_table[0][i].update(terminal_rules[word])

    # Fill for lengths 2 to n
    for length in range(2, n + 1):
        for i in range(n - length + 1):
            j = i + length - 1 # end_index
            for k in range(i, j): # split point
                # Substring from i to k has length (k - i + 1)
                # Substring from k+1 to j has length (j - (k + 1) + 1)
                
                # In dp_table, length is (length-1)
                for B in dp_table[k - i][i]: 
                    for C in dp_table[j - (k + 1)][k + 1]: 
                        if (B, C) in rules:
                            dp_table[length - 1][i].update(rules[(B, C)])

    return 'S' in dp_table[n-1][0]

    P = collections.defaultdict(lambda: collections.defaultdict(set))

    terminal_rules = collections.defaultdict(list)
    non_terminal_rules = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for rule in grammar_rules:

            non_terminal_rules[(rule[1], rule[2])].append(rule[0])
            
    # Base case: substrings of length 1

    # Fill the table for substrings of increasing length

        for i in range(n - length + 1): # start index of the current substring

                # Left substring: starts at i, length k

                    for C in right_non_terminals:
                        if (B, C) in non_terminal_rules:
